coordinateSystem.x: +X along the boom, positive toward waterside (sea side)
coordinateSystem.z: along the rails (gantry travel). +Z is the right-hand side for a viewer standing landside and looking toward the water
coordinateSystem.origin: top of the waterside rail on the crane transverse centreline (landside rail at X = -30)
coordinateSystem.sideNames: Leg/corner suffix 'a' = +Z end, 'b' = -Z end. 'ws' = waterside (X = 0), 'ls' = landside (X = -30)

provenanceKinds.measured: dimension printed on the cited sheet, used as an exact input
provenanceKinds.drawing-derived: computed from printed dimensions (formula in the note)
provenanceKinds.estimated: visual estimate from a scaled reading of the cited view; provisional 5 % silhouette tolerance
provenanceKinds.approximate-location: placed inside a documented area; exact position/shape not established
